note: The species was misidentified in the literature as G. caudomunitus Kemner (Maiti, 1983).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The holotype soldier is deposited in the Department of Zoology, University of the Punjab, Lahore; the type locality is Ukhia, Bangladesh. The alate, soldier and pseudergate are all described.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule red-brown to dark brown; anteclypeus transparent, postclypeus pale brown; labrum and antennae brown, not darker than the head (Akhtar 1975 recorded them as darker than the head); pronotum paler than the head; coxae and femora brown, tibiae and tarsi pale; wings pale brown; abdominal tergites darker than the pronotum. Head sparsely hairy; apical and middle parts of the labrum with several short hairs; pronotum more hairy, margins and body with long and short hairs. Body length with wings 5.5—6.0 mm, without wings 4.0—4.3 mm. Head capsule nearly as wide as long, sides nearly parallel; Y-shaped suture indistinct; length to the mandibular bases 0.75—0.86 mm, width including eyes 0.78—0.86 mm. Eyes oval, slightly convex; maximum diameter 0.25—0.27 mm. Ocelli small, broadly oval, not touching or just touching the eyes; length 0.07—0.08 mm, width 0.05—0.06 mm. Labrum wide, lingulate, wider than long, anterior margin nearly straight. Mandibles of the typical Kalotermes type: no distinct notch between the 1st and 2nd marginal teeth of the left mandible; antennae 11—12 segments, with 11 segments segment 3 only slightly shorter than 2, with 12 segments segment 3 short and annular, subsequent segments progressively longer. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, anterior margin weakly concave, anterolateral corners pointed, sides nearly straight or convex; posterior margin convex, without a median notch; length 0.45—0.50 mm, width 0.65—0.73 mm. Legs short, stout; tibial spur formula 3:3:3. Abdomen elongate; cerci 2-segmented; male styli finger-like, single-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brown, darker near the postclypeus and frons; anteclypeus brownish yellow; labrum yellowish brown; mandibles red-black; antennae brownish yellow; pronotum brown; legs brownish yellow; abdomen yellowish brown, the 10th tergite sclerotized, red-brown. Head sparsely hairy; the anterior margin and middle of the labrum with long setae; thorax and abdomen more hairy. Body length 4.25—5.20 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly parallel; length 1.3—1.45 mm, about 1.44 times the width (0.90—0.99 mm); dorsal protuberance indistinct; frons sloping forward at about 45°. Eyes present but indistinct; ocelli not discernible. Antennae 10—11 segments; segment 2 longer than 3 or 4; segment 3 shorter than 4. Labrum as long as wide (length 0.18 mm, width 0.23 mm), anterior margin slightly rounded. Mandibles short, length 0.50—0.57 mm, basal swelling weak; mandibular index 0.39—0.42, less than half the head length; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the 1st and 2nd adjacent, the 3rd nearly central, the margin between the 2nd and 3rd incurved without a notch; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth situated at the middle. Postmentum clavate, the waist long and weakly constricted; length 0.89—0.93 mm, maximum width 0.40—0.41 mm, waist width 0.21—0.23 mm. Pronotum subrectangular, flat, slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin weakly concave, anterolateral corners narrowly rounded; posterior margin nearly straight, at the middle slightly concave; length 0.44—0.48 mm, width 0.66—0.78 mm. Legs short, stout; tibial spur formula 3:3:3. Abdomen elongate, the 10th tergite more strongly sclerotized.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudergate: head capsule pale cream to pale brownish yellow; antennae, body and legs paler, labrum slightly darker. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length 4.0—5.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular, length to the mandibular bases (0.75—0.88 mm) equal to the width (0.75—0.85 mm); sutures indistinct. Eye vestiges circular, diameter 0.1—0.13 mm. Antennae short.
